quotations.old_english: Swylce eal Finnes buruh [MS. Finns] fýrenu wǽre
quotations.english: as if all Fin's castle were on fire

quotations.old_english: Swylce hie æt Finnes hám findaa meahton
quotations.english: such as they might find at Finnesham

source_text: Finns buruh = Finnes burh; gen. -burge; f. Finnsburg :-- Swylce eal Finnes buruh [MS. Finns] fýrenu wǽre as if all Fin's castle were on fire, Fins. Th. 72; Fin. 36. This Finnsburg is no doubt the same as the Finnesham mentioned by Beowulf, -- Swylce hie æt Finnes hám findaa meahton such as they might find at Finnesham, Beo. Th. 2316; B. 1156. v. Finn.
